# #38 — feat: add entity/link tables for explicit adjacency

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy

## Goal
Add explicit entity/link/adjacency support for Open Brain session lanes and existing memory entries.

## Motivation
pgvector provides semantic adjacency, but operational memory also needs explicit relationships: this session changed this workflow, this blocker depends on this host, this artifact supersedes that one, this decision came from that incident.

## Proposed tables

```sql
CREATE TABLE ob_entities (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  entity_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- host, repo, workflow, service, agent, channel, file, command, etc.
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  canonical_id TEXT,
  namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
  metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  embedding vector,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE ob_links (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  from_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  from_id UUID NOT NULL,
  to_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  to_id UUID NOT NULL,
  relation TEXT NOT NULL, -- artifact, depends_on, supersedes, caused_by, same_lane, adjacent, etc.
  weight DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT 1.0,
  metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

## Acceptance criteria
- A lane can link to artifacts, workflows, hosts, agents, and decisions.
- Search results can include explicit links plus pgvector neighbors.
- Existing `relationships`/`projects` tables remain compatible.
- Obsidian sync can render links without losing OB source IDs.
